The operation principle of ultrasonic water meters is to measure flow by emitting high-frequency sound waves (ultrasound) through water and calculating the time it takes for signals to travel between sensors in both directions.     The water meters Iskrasonic 1000 can be installed to operate in all positions and are not designed to measure the reverse flow. **2.
